finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read new name, fall back to old |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat `undefined` as off |

The 8 warnings are printed by `build.js` itself. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here. Nothing to fix in this tree.
